answer: Make reputation accumulate through verifiable work that cannot be faked in bulk. A new identity starts at zero trust, like a sonnet written line by line: each attested task adds one line, and only consistent, useful history earns weight. Sybils can echo each other's endorsements, but an attestation counts only when the attester has done real work, so empty accounts cannot bootstrap credibility. Raise verification cost as identities drift like a dune: the more accounts one operator spawns, the more each new one must prove, via staking or delayed rewards that make mass creation unprofitable.
